title: Kantan reminders plugin settings
description: The 'config.settings' block of a module running kantan-plugin-reminders. At least one list is needed.

format.description: Format string for the bar display value.

persist.description: Keep the module in the bar while its only reminders are completed ones it keeps.

persistShape.description: The module's shape while it persists with nothing incomplete.

lists.description: Reminders lists to monitor, each matched by its exact name.

icon.description: Icon shown in place of the module's while this list's reminder is displayed.

lookahead.description: Show dated reminders due within this long from now, such as 10m, 1h or 2d.

overdue.description: Include reminders past their due date.

undated.description: Include reminders with no due date.

completedRetention.description: How long to keep completed reminders in the menu, such as 30m, 1h or 2d. 0 hides them.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of a reminder's title before it is cut short. 0 keeps the whole title.

action.description: Icon for the Reminders action at the bottom of the menu.
